chunks.title: LEQ — Long Essay Question (6 points) — Q4 Set 1: Nazism vs. Communism
chunks.content: AP European History LEQ, 6 points, standardized rubric. A Thesis/Claim [1]. B Contextualization [1]. C Evidence [0–2]: two specific pieces (1), used to support the argument (1). D Analysis and Reasoning [0–2]: reasoning process (comparison) (1), complex understanding (1). Q4 Set 1 prompt: compare Nazism and Communism as ideologies/regimes. Common failure: no defensible thesis; contextualization too brief; reasoning without complexity.
